speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on your history of risperidone use, I am specifically looking for signs of Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) or Tardive Dyskinesia. Have you developed a high fever, severe muscle rigidity, or confusion in the last 48 hours? Also, do you feel an uncontrollable urge to move your tongue or lips?

REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Kinase, Prothrombin_Time, Partial_Thromboplastin_Time.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for providing those normal readings. While I have ruled out metabolic causes, I need to clarify the specific nature of your involuntary movements: are they rhythmic and repetitive (suggesting tardive dyskinesia) or sustained and painful (suggesting acute dystonia or parkinsonism)? Additionally, are you currently experiencing any autonomic instability, such as fluctuating blood pressure, heart rate changes, or profuse sweating, which would raise concern for Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome?

REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Kinase
REQUEST IMAGES: Facial_Muscle_Video

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you; the normal Creatine Kinase levels make Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome unlikely. To confirm the nature of the movement disorder, have you noticed rhythmic, chewing-like movements of the lips or tongue (suggestive of tardive dyskinesia) or are the movements sustained and painful (suggestive of acute dystonia)? Please also confirm if you have experienced these symptoms while sleeping.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Movement Disorder (Suspected Tardive Dyskinesia)
